# inirules — module contract (authoritative)

`inirules.py` at the worktree root: `parse(text) -> dict` parses a project-specific
INI dialect into `{section: {key: value}}`. Keys before any section header belong to
the root section `""`.

## Lines

- Blank lines are ignored. **Comments start with `#` at the very beginning of a line
  only** — a `#` inside a value is ordinary text, never a comment.
- Section header: `[name]` on its own line; `name` must be non-empty; a malformed
  header raises `ValueError`.
- Key/value: `key = value`. The key must be non-empty (else `ValueError`). A line that
  is none of these raises `ValueError`.
- A `key =` with nothing after `=` gives the empty string `""`.

## Values

- Surrounding whitespace of an unquoted value is stripped; a **quoted** value
  (`"..."`) keeps its inner whitespace exactly and may contain `=`. Inside quotes the
  only escapes are `\"` (a quote) and `\\` (a backslash); any other backslash is a
  literal backslash. Quotes are only recognized when the value both starts and ends
  with `"`.

## Continuation

- A value (or a quoted value's opening segment) that ends with `\` continues on the
  next line. The backslash markers are removed, the segments (each stripped of
  surrounding whitespace) are joined with a **single space**, and quoting is applied to
  the joined result.

## Duplicates

- Duplicate keys within a section: **last wins**. A repeated section header re-opens
  the section (its keys merge).

## General

- Non-`str` input raises `TypeError`. Standard library only. This document is the
  authoritative statement of the module's behavior.
